proof_body:
by
  intro f f' a b hab hc hd hp ha hb
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hfx⟩ := intermediate_value_Ioo hab.le hc (show (0 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Ioo (f a) (f b) from ⟨ha, hb⟩)
  refine ⟨x, ⟨hx, hfx⟩, ?_⟩
  rintro y ⟨hy, hfy⟩
  have key : ∀ u ∈ Set.Ioo a b, ∀ v ∈ Set.Ioo a b, u < v → f u < f v := by
    intro u hu v hv huv
    have hsub : Set.Icc u v ⊆ Set.Icc a b := Set.Icc_subset_Icc hu.1.le hv.2.le
    obtain ⟨c, hc1, hc2⟩ := exists_hasDerivAt_eq_slope f f' huv (hc.mono hsub) (fun z hz => hd z ⟨hu.1.trans hz.1, hz.2.trans hv.2⟩)
    have hcpos := hp c ⟨hu.1.trans hc1.1, hc1.2.trans hv.2⟩
    rw [hc2] at hcpos
    have hpos : 0 < v - u := by linarith
    have := (div_pos_iff_of_pos_right hpos).mp hcpos
    linarith
  rcases lt_trichotomy y x with h | h | h
  · have := key y hy x hx h; linarith
  · exact h
  · have := key x hx y hy h; linarith
target_source: ∀ (f f' : ℝ → ℝ) (a b : ℝ), a < b → ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc a b) → (∀ x ∈ Set.Ioo a b, HasDerivAt f (f' x) x) → (∀ x ∈ Set.Ioo a b, 0 < f' x) → f a < 0 → 0 < f b → ∃! x, x ∈ Set.Ioo a b ∧ f x = 0
